description: Classify dates by season and El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO) phase using NOAA ONI data.

tasks.title: Season classification
tasks.description: Implement compute_season(date) that maps a date string to a season name by extracting the month from character positions 6-7.
tasks.notes: Internal function (not exported). Month boundaries: Jan-Mar (01-03) Winter, Apr-Jun (04-06) Spring, Jul-Sep (07-09) Summer, Oct-Dec (10-12) Fall. Test file: tests/testthat/test_compute_season.R

tasks.title: ONI data wrangling
tasks.description: Implement functions to reshape wide-format ONI data to long format and extract nine consecutive ONI values centered on a given year and trimester.
acceptance_criteria: transform_roni_data_to_longer(wide_oni_df) returns a data frame with columns 'Year', 'months', 'values'
lookup_season_column(month) maps month 1-12 to trimester abbreviations DJF, JFM, FMA, MAM, AMJ, MJJ, JJA, JAS, ASO, SON, OND, NDJ respectively
lookup_nine_oni_values(long_oni_df, 2023, "JAS") returns a numeric vector of length 9
tasks.notes: All internal functions. Input ONI data is in wide format: Year + 12 trimester columns (DJF, JFM, FMA, MAM, AMJ, MJJ, JJA, JAS, ASO, SON, OND, NDJ). lookup_nine_oni_values finds the row matching year and trimester, then returns rows (index-4):(index+4) from the values column. Test fixture: /workdir/tests/data/roni_data.csv (wide), /workdir/tests/data/transformed_roni_data.csv (long). Tests in tests/testthat/test_enso.R.

tasks.title: ENSO phase rule engine
tasks.description: Implement classify_enso_phase(oni_values) that classifies a vector of 9 ONI values as Niño, Niña, or Neutral using a consecutive-threshold rule. Implement has_consecutive_threshold_values(runs) as a helper.
tasks.notes: Both internal functions. Classification rules: (1) 5+ consecutive values >= 0.5 -> Niño, checked first. (2) 5+ consecutive values <= -0.5 -> Niña, checked second. (3) Otherwise -> Neutral. has_consecutive_threshold_values uses rle() and checks if any true run has length >= 5. Tests in tests/testthat/test_enso.R.

tasks.title: Orchestration
tasks.description: Implement compute_enso(date, oni_data) to wire together the ONI wrangling and phase classification pipeline, and classify_by_season_and_enso_phase(data_with_date, noaa_data) as the main exported entry point.
acceptance_criteria: classify_by_season_and_enso_phase(data_with_date, noaa_data_df) returns a data frame with columns 'Date', 'Season', 'ENSO_Phase'
For data_with_date$Date = c("2023-08", "2025-01", "2024-04"), the Season column is c("Summer", "Winter", "Spring") and the ENSO_Phase column is c("Niño", "Niña", "Neutral")
tasks.notes: compute_enso is internal; classify_by_season_and_enso_phase is exported (in NAMESPACE). compute_enso pipeline: lubridate::ym(date) -> extract year/month -> lookup_season_column -> transform_roni_data_to_longer -> lookup_nine_oni_values -> classify_enso_phase. classify_by_season_and_enso_phase uses comprehenr::to_vec to iterate over dates. Test fixture: /workdir/tests/data/roni_data.csv. Tests in tests/testthat/test_enso.R and tests/testthat/test_classify_by_season_and_enso_phase.R.

tasks.title: CLI option definitions
tasks.description: Implement get_domain_specific_options() using gecioptparse to define three domain-specific CLI options with defaults and help text.
acceptance_criteria: get_domain_specific_options() returns an object with names c("data-path", "roni-path", "output-path")
tasks.notes: Exported function. Uses gecioptparse::character_option(a) for each option and gecioptparse::get_options_from_vec() to combine. Short flags: -d (data-path), -r (roni-path), -o (output-path). Help texts: 'File path of the weather station data', 'File path of the ONI data (regional ocean climate data)', 'File path of the classified weather data output'. Returns a named list (optparse output format). DESCRIPTION needs gecioptparse in Imports and IslasGECI/gecioptparse in Remotes. Test file: tests/testthat/test_get_domain_specific_options.R.
